text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh me, oh my! Just look at all these new
faces...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall introduce myself to each and
every one of
you once we've returned
home. But first...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing so many new
friends into
my life, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee... My room is going to become
quite lively
indeed. ♪
